title: The Bamboo Species Used in The Production of Musical Instruments by ...
text: In this study, 31 instruments produced by four indigenous communities: Kalinga (Lubuagan subtribe), Majukayong, Bagobo-Tagabawa, and T'boli are documented and the bamboo species used in making them were identified. The instruments were classified into idiophones (21), aerophones (8), membranophones (1) and chordophones (1).
